purpose: Tier E sanity-check figures for Banteay Meanchey, October 2020 floods (plan section 5: catch absurd results only, never a score).
event: October 2020 Cambodia floods (monsoon trough + Tropical Storm Linfa)

figures.source: press reporting of NCDM / provincial agriculture department figures, October 2020
figures.note: Inundated, not necessarily destroyed. Date of assessment not stated precisely; likely cumulative over the event rather than a single-date extent.

figures.scope: Banteay Meanchey province (of 39 nationally at that report date)

figures.source: humanitarian reporting cited in the project plan

figures.scope: Cambodia, national, 14 provinces, as of 26 Oct 2020

how_to_use: A single-date satellite flood extent is NOT the same quantity as a cumulative event-total 'inundated area' report: the report may aggregate areas flooded at different times, and may count a whole field as inundated when only part of it was.

The check is one-sided and coarse: a detected new-water area on cropland of the same order as ~282 km2 is consistent; an area ten times larger or ten times smaller needs explaining before anything else is claimed.
Never tune a threshold, model or post-processing step to move a number toward these figures (plan rule 10, Mistake_avoidance #3).
